svg.title: Example with made-up inputs: cost per day for kibble, a topper, and full fresh
svg.desc: Example with made-up inputs, not real prices; the reader should plug in their own quotes. Three illustrative bars, not shelf prices. Kibble is 1.43 dollars a day from 5 dollars a kilogram, 3500 kilocalories a kilogram, and 1000 kilocalories a day. Topper is 0.71 dollars of that kibble for 500 kilocalories plus an illustrative 4 dollars of fresh, totalling 4.71. Full fresh is an illustrative 8 dollars for 1000 kilocalories. 27 Sep 2026.
svg.text: Example cost per day, not a subscription price
Example with made-up prices ($5/kg kibble at 3,500 kcal/kg; $4 and $8 fresh). Plug in yours.
Scale: the $8 bar is 360 px. Arithmetic as of 27 Sep 2026. No company price was opened.
